prompt: Our AI incident response plan cites NIST AI RMF MANAGE 3 for incident handling and response. Is that the right anchor?
assertions: States no: MANAGE 3 covers managing AI risks and benefits from third-party entities
Anchors incident response correctly in MANAGE 4 (post-deployment monitoring in 4.1, incident and error communication to relevant AI actors in 4.3)
States MANAGE has 4 categories and 13 subcategories
Places risk treatment and prioritization under MANAGE 1
Does not cite invented MANAGE subcategories
